chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Musa, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Jallab, from Musa ibn Ismail, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from one of our companions, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The carrots are a security from the colitis, and the hemorrhoids, and it aids upon the copulation'.
ai.seo_question: What are the medicinal benefits of carrots according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the medicinal virtues of carrots (al-jazar), noting their efficacy in treating colitis and hemorrhoids while also serving as an aphrodisiac. This narration reflects the broader Shia tradition of integrating practical health advice with spiritual teachings, emphasizing the body as an amanah entrusted by God. The specific mention of sexual health underscores the holistic view of well-being in Imami scholarship, where physical vitality supports spiritual devotion.
